timeline.tweet: I want to say for anyone who might be worried after reading this, while I feel very sad lately, I’m not feeling suicidal.

I was diagnosed with depression and anxiety in 2012. I don’t think I’ve been at the point of wanting to kill myself, but I can understand how hopeless things can seem, and how someone can get to that point.
